notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/5b286abca43ca3cae22d23a1102a3f6c3d776676.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Dear friends,[/b][/p][p align="start"]It’s been a while since our last post about the [b]vampire project[/b] — time to fix that!
Development is moving slowly but surely. Our artist has finally set up their workspace, which means new art and scenes are on the way.[/p][p align="start"]For now, here’s a fresh illustration: our vampire girl peacefully sleeping on a couch. Looks like even immortals need some rest — especially after a long night. 🦇😴[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for waiting and supporting us — you’re the reason this project stays alive. ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Heroes Saga!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear friends,[/b][/p][p]We are excited to present our new project – a [b]fantasy game of magic, intrigue, and temptation![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to Atris[/b] – a world where strangers are summoned through mysterious rituals and called Heroes. But in this world, [b]Heroes are nothing more than tools in the hands of others.[/b] Who will survive, and who will quickly vanish – is decided by fate… and your choices.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/91ec91b7d75f411275a37b65d9b4d6c42399a78b.png"][/img][/p][p]You play as an [b]ordinary young man[/b] who finds himself on the continent of Valarion. Locals see him as a new Hero, and every influential force strives to use him for their own purposes.
You will have to make tough decisions: trust and betray, fight and survive, build relationships and uncover hidden secrets.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/30fa76b4e36a1f08cc67b57933f7acc4fe621328.png"][/img][/p][p][b]In the game you will find:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A well-developed, living world full of conflicts and mysteries[/p][/*][*][p]Political intrigues and the struggle for power[/p][/*][*][p]Romantic storylines with beautiful ladies (including 18+ scenes)[/p][/*][*][p]Turn-based battles and mini-games[/p][/*][*][p]Tough choices that influence the story[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/443e9c599f95aa8e6a97317e7337235e76a8c680.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The demo version of the game will be released very soon![/b]
But right now, you can already watch the trailer and read a detailed description on the Steam page.[/p][p][b]Add the game to your wishlist[/b] – this will help the project reach a new level and give us huge support at the start.[/p][p][b]Steam:[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3894300"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]Attention!!![/b] The game page opens only when authorized in Steam.[/p]

notes.title: Knightly Passions Version 1.6 — Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/e877dea7d842e244f59666d2473718f315c6a244.png[/img]

Dear friends,

We’re pleased to present you with a new update of [b]Knightly Passions — Version 1.6[/b]. This update was essential to fulfilling the many wishes and requests our players have shared since the game’s Steam release. Also, Version 1.60 is the final step towards beginning to translate the game into additional languages. We know how many of you have been waiting for greater language support. Patience, friends! More languages will be coming soon!

[b]What awaits you in this update? Here’s the full list of all the changes and additions to the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added “New Game+” mode.[/b] This will be unlocked after completing the game for the first time. In this mode, you can choose to skip whichever quests you wish when you start a new game (especially useful for people trying to collect all the game’s achievements or replay specific quests without a convenient save).
[*] [b]Added BONUS SCENES to the gallery (five old 18+ scenes)[/b]. Please note: This is not new content. We’ve decided to show you scenes that were originally intended to be part of the game, but were later replaced by remade Live2D versions. You can compare the old versions to the new ones to see how much the animation quality has improved. One of the scenes was completely cut out; it will be new to many players.
[*] [b]All major characters now have names[/b]. The following characters received names: the tavern keeper, the witch, the blonde nun, the vampiress, and the arms trader.
[*] [b]The comic-style segment with the elf’s “tail” has returned, and we’ve improved the text in the elf’s 18+ scene.[/b] The comic-style segment was cut in the past due to plot changes.
[*] [b]Partially fixed the combat bug involving enemy attack animations.[/b] If you’ve encountered animation problems in combat, you can enable/disable attack animations by clicking on the action point bubble in the combat screen.
[*] [b]Added the ability to sort inventory items.[/b] Simply click on the “Sort” button in your inventory screen and your items will be put in order.
[*] [b]Traders’ stocks now refresh daily. [/b]Previously, items sold to traders appeared as available to be bought back long after you’d sold them. Now, you can only buy back items you sold earlier the same day. The entire stock will refresh at the end of the day and any items you’ve sold to a trader will disappear.
[*] [b]Improved dialogues with the elf inside the player’s house.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed a bug with the achievement for opening all 18+ scenes in the gallery.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed a bug with the scale of flying serpents in combat.[/b]
[*] [b]Improved the text in the 18+ scene in the field with Mirina (and removed the “to be continued” text).[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed a bug with Quest 22 still appearing in the journal after it had been completed.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed minor trading bugs.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed many other bugs and probably added new ones.[/b]
[*] [b]And much more.[/b]
[/list]
[i]Friends, thank you so very much for your support! Thank you to everyone who not only helps the project financially, but also shares their ideas and thoughts about the gameplay. Your feedback in comments, private messages, and emails is genuinely invaluable!

Thank you for your tremendous support, your faith in our team, and of course, your LOVE for the game! It’s thanks to you that we’re able to keep marching forward! A huge, heartfelt [b]THANK YOU[/b] to each and every one of you!

[b]Sincerely,
Team FEYADA[/b][/i]

notes.title: Working Tirelessly!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/fcd7d35f377dfaa327ebeb0a148247ca6f698428.png[/img]
Friends, we’d like to share the latest news about the projects we’re currently working on.

First, let’s talk about the vampire project. This game is a really cool experiment that we’ve begun implementing in the Unity engine. Admittedly, the transition from Ren’Py to Unity hasn’t been easy for our programmers, but the extra trouble has been well worth it. Animations work better in Unity than in Ren’Py, which has been a big leap forward for us. But animations alone aren’t enough, so we’re trying to come up with interesting mechanics and character interactions to keep players engaged and ensure that the game is truly a game, and not purely a visual novel. We can confidently say that the game will have many different endings and the release of the first version (0.1) is planned for the 2nd or 3rd quarter of 2025. SOON, we’ll show you the game’s world map — it’s much larger than in Knightly Passions. And yes, we haven’t forgotten that this takes place in the same universe as Knightly Passions, so the LORE of KP will grow thanks to this project.

Now let’s talk about the bunker project. When we say “bunker,” many people immediately think of the Fallout universe (admittedly including some of us). We feel that while Fallout-inspired themes are very popular, they’ve been done to death at this point, so we decided to break the mold by making a game about a bunker that the main character enters owing to random happenstance rather than nuclear war, a bunker from which he wants to escape but cannot. The game is being created with a big emphasis on humor (which we’ll try not to overdo, since we know firsthand that endless gags and jokes get very tiresome). The game will also be a dating simulator. A dating sim in a sealed bunker? BUT HOW? You’ll see for yourself soon! The game is being developed in the Ren’Py engine, and the 1st version is also scheduled for release in the 2nd or 3rd quarter of 2025.

But what about Knightly Passions? This spring (autumn in the Southern Hemisphere), we’ll release a new update, Version 1.6, that will fully prepare the game to be translated into additional languages. We’ll be making some dialogue revisions and adding in bonus content (old 18+ scenes that were removed in later stages of development). Don’t forget to ask us for your Steam key if you’re a subscriber!

To wrap up the news, we’ll answer the most common question we’ve heard from players:

When will we see the next installment of Knightly Passions? Will there be a Knightly Passions 2?

Answer:

After we tell and show you the vampiress’s full backstory, we’ll start work on Knightly Passions 2 right away. The vampire game will answer many questions that’ve been asked about why we didn’t include more vampire content in Knightly Passions and will expand the LORE of the KP universe. It’s exactly what we need to prepare you for the larger, second installment of Knightly Passions.

Sincerely,

Team FEYADA

notes.title: News about Version 1.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/0b62d7fbad6e469dc8eff2cb4f4215e1c20462d3.jpg[/img]
Dear friends,

We’re currently working on update 1.6 for Knightly Passions. In it, we’ll be adding bonus content to the game — namely, the early 18+ scenes that were cut in later development phases.

In addition to the 18+ scenes, the game will receive even more polish. This version will be the jumping-off point for translating the game into additional languages because we’re making the requisite text edits to be able to start working on other translations.

notes.title: Release — Knightly Passions: In the Grip of Ice!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

The long-awaited winter-themed DLC, “[b]In the Grip of Ice[/b],” has just been released on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/1ee111bb7f5062c371bf9bb4a1b2ad60ff91bdea.png[/img]
In this add-on, you must contend with the machinations of icy powers intent on shattering the town’s peace at any cost. To defeat this evil, you’ll have to infiltrate the perilous Ice Palace, where devious traps and merciless guardians await uninvited guests around every corner. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/c5c97741e98f56554e7c50a12e2d6fc9aa4334c1.jpg[/img]

Will our dauntless hunter find the courage to challenge the Ice Queen? And will he have the compassion to thaw her frozen heart?

[b]To celebrate the release, the DLC is being offered at a 10% discount.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3163410/Knightly_Passions_In_the_Grip_of_Ice/

[b]This DLC will also be included in the Platinum Edition bundle:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44858/Knightly_Passions__Platinum_Edition/

Additionally, we’ve updated the main game to version 1.30. Here’s the full change log:
[list]
[*] Fixed most of the spelling errors in the original Russian text, which will allow us to translate the game into other languages.
[*] Added sound effects for opening the journal/inventory, pressing buttons, spending/receiving gold, etc.
[*] Reworked notifications (“Quest completed!”, “Task completed!”, “Item received!”, etc.)
[*] Corrected sprite expressions in Quests 1 and 3.
[*] Fixed a mistake in Quest 11.
[*] Fixed several bugs.
[*] And much more.
[/list]
[i]We’re so grateful to you all for supporting us! Friends, without you, we wouldn’t be able to pour all our heart and passion into the games we make. Thank you very much![/i]

[i][b]Sincerely,
Your FEYADA Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Future plans!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/eafca4eb2977190de6ae192a714dcae3ed1f803b.jpg[/img]
Dear friends,

Today, we’d like to share [b]our plans for the near future with you[/b]. We’re pleased to report that the next chapter of the story of the hunter and his sister won’t remain a mystery forever; we unequivocally will not leave it untold.

[b]Knightly Passions[/b] is our first project. We’ve hit an awful lot of bumps over the past five years in the course of bringing you the game you see today. Our small team has picked up [b]some incredible experience[/b], so you can count on us to continue making the best, highest-quality games we can.

Our lead artist, [b]Lodi[/b], says that it’s time to freshen up our art a bit. It’s very good, but he’s had to make some adjustments and compromises over the years to fit the course we first set [b]five years ago[/b]. It bears mentioning that [b]Lodi has drawn 99% of the whole game[/b], and he’s been struggling to find an assistant artist since every artist has their own distinct visual style. He truly loves this project and all the people who’ve been working on it, which is why he reached out to artists who wanted to work with him. Basically the full graphical load rests on Lodi’s shoulders (everything from the adult scenes to the tiniest UI elements), and that has been slowing down the game’s development. Just think: [b]Nearly the entire game is drawn by a single, solitary person, who hand-crafts every image down to the smallest detail[/b]. It’s an extremely difficult job, one that no artist should have to do alone.

After speaking with him, we’ve come to understand that he’d like to find an assistant artist who’s a cut above the rest. If you or someone you know is an artist who fits that bill, please send us a message in [b]Discord[/b]:
[b]https://discord.gg/3BAHKxQzjE[/b]

[b]So, what comes next? What is Team FEYADA doing for the rest of this year?[/b]

We’re slowly updating and putting the finishing touches on the game as we release bugfix patches. Players should be able to play through [b]Knightly Passions[/b] from start to finish without encountering a single bug; if people manage to find more bugs, rest assured we’ll be continuing to fix them in updates. Our attention was recently drawn to some balance issues with the [b]Tactical difficulty mode[/b], which has proven to be fairly easy. In addition to bugfixing and polishing, we’ll be working on making [b]Tactical mode[/b] as difficult as we originally meant it to be. Trust us, you’ll see the game in a whole new light when you’re having vivid, intense battles with your foes.

We’ve also been planning to[b] add support for additional languages to the game[/b]. The first language in line is Chinese. However, before we start introducing new translations to Knightly Passions, we need to ensure the game is polished to perfection, which is what we’re doing now.

We’d also like to [b]add voice acting to our characters during adult scenes[/b]. If you all support the idea, we’ll absolutely include it in a future update.

Now, let’s talk about upcoming releases. [b]We intend to release two DLCs by the end of this year:[/b]

[b]DLC #1 will be released this summer.
DLC #2 will be released this winter.[/b]

[b]Follow our development news to stay abreast of all the announcements on the subject.[/b]

In addition to everything above, [b]we’ve already begun formulating plans for another project[/b]. The formal announcement of that project is scheduled to happen before the end of the year.

As you can see, we have no shortage of work ahead of us. We’ll be continuing to delight you by continuing to sweat day and night. But without you, friends, none of this could’ve happened. Therefore, on behalf of everyone in [b]Team FEYADA[/b], we’d like to express our profound gratitude to you, [b]friends, for all of your unbelievable support.[/b]

[b]You’re amazing! You’re the reason we do this! Thank you so very much! [/b]

notes.title: Resolved: Stuttering and Freezes in Combat; Animation Problems.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/ce737434ac600b63ba377738794a58defc5c06c5.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Preface: If your game runs like a Swiss watch, then skip this message, but if you’re experiencing any strange lagging in combat, stuttering, or freezing, then this post is for you[/i][/b].

Dear friends,

Some players have reported experiencing [b]freezing and stuttering issues during battles[/b]. Several players have also reported [b]problems with animations.[/b]

If you’re experiencing the issues described above, there are [b]3 potential reasons why:[/b]

[b]Cause #1: A weak computer. [/b]Not many people play on a computer with less than 4 GB of RAM and 2 GB of VRAM (video card memory) these days, but if you’re having problems with the game, then the issue may be weak computer hardware.
[b]Solution: [/b]If weak hardware seems like the problem, try playing the game on a more powerful computer or consider upgrading your computer’s hardware.

[b]Cause #2: Video Card Drivers. [/b]This is a very common source of problems with animations not displaying correctly.
[b]Solution: [/b]Update your video card with the latest drivers and everything should work.

If you have a good gaming computer and your drivers are all up to date, then the next step should help resolve your problem.

[b]Cause #3: The Ren’Py engine.[/b] Sometimes, the Ren’Py engine doesn’t automatically detect the renderer correctly, and it has to be manually switched on.
[b]Solution:[/b] Hold down SHIFT on your keyboard and launch the game on Steam while continuing to hold SHIFT. Keep holding SHIFT until a gray window pops up like in the image below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/491157b99f49c53f85770b2e04a35e8056eed28f.png[/img]

In this window, under “Renderer,” select [b]Force ANGLE2 Renderer[/b]. Then click [b]Exit[/b]. Your changes will be saved. Now, without pressing any special buttons, launch the game and see if freezes continue to occur. If changing the renderer solved the problem, great! If not, repeat the process, but this time set your renderer as Force GL2 Renderer.

[b]If none of this helps, then we strongly recommend turning off combat animations.[/b] How do you do that? During combat, click on your stamina points in the top center of the screen, which will send you to the combat preferences menu. Disable all animations, then resume the combat.

[b]We hope this helps those of you who’ve been experiencing technical difficulties with the game.[/b]

notes.title: Version 1.04 (Bugfix Patch). Steam Cloud, Remote Play, etc.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/1f92b97331ac9c35f6196f7c117a9539d3dc918d.png[/img]

Dear friends,

We’ve just released a new update, [b]Version 1.04[/b], that contains several bugfixes:

[list]
[*] [b]The HP bars of enemies[/b] now appear where they’re supposed to during combat. Previously, the HP bars of certain enemies were concealed behind the player’s cards.
[*] The [b]“Targeted Reflection”[/b] combat skill card now works as intended. Your current defense value is no longer lowered by using it.
[*] The chance of catching a question-mark item is now [b]5% when fishing.[/b]
[*] Fixed certain achievements resetting when attempting to start a new game [b](namely: Haggler, Jack-Of-All-Trades, Craftsman, Chef, “You Know, You Want to Live,” Overnight, and “Okay, I’ll Bite.”)[/b]
[/list]
Today, we also set up cloud saving via the [b]Steam Cloud[/b] with support for cross-platform saves, implemented the [b]Remote Play[/b] option, and implemented [b]Family Library Sharing[/b]. Please give these features a try and let us know if any of them are broken or not functioning as intended.

[i][b]Thank you to everyone who’s written us messages in comments and reviews! We rarely have time to respond directly due to our workloads, but we’re reading every one of your messages. Thank you to all the players who’ve purchased and played our game! Thank you to all of you, friends! You’re the greatest![/b][/i]

notes.content:

Dear friends,

We've just updated the game to [b]Version 1.02[/b]. The main fix of 1.02 is correcting the behavior of [b]loaded save files[/b]. In Version 1.01, loading a save could make the game roll back your progress, causing it to be lost. Now, in Version 1.02, loading a save will not trigger such a rollback and no progress will be lost when loading saves.

We've also fixed issues with the dropping of certain [b]Steam achievements[/b].

We're seeing your lightning-fast feedback in comments and discussions, and it sounds like some players are encountering problems with the gallery. We also see that some people are encountering other errors. As soon as we work out these bugs, we'll release a new bugfix update and notify you of it immediately in a news post.

We apologize for any inconvenience these bugs have caused. We hear you; we just need a little time to fix up the game.

notes.title: Version 1.0 News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/515b78181a180ee3103588e34abe29115e08c216.png[/img]
Dear friends,

As you know, Knightly Passions will be released on Steam on [b]April 26th, 2024[/b]. We’ll attempt to briefly go over what we’re working on right now.

In Version 1.0, we’ll be introducing two difficulty modes: [b]“Adventure” and “Tactical.”[/b] We’ve already got these modes functioning nicely, but we still have a lot of balancing ahead of us, which is going to be quite a bit of work.

In the new version, we’ll be thoroughly revisiting quest rewards. We’ve concluded that sometimes, rather than gold, you might prefer to receive a good sword, bow, piece of armor, or combat skill card so that the quest reward feels more impactful. Additionally, several quests will be receiving both textual and graphical improvements.

Some items will be cheaper in 1.0, while weapons will be more expensive. We’re trying to make it so that players don’t need too much money in general, but buying a good sword will require several quests’ worth of gold. We’re also considering making the price of items vary based on the difficulty mode. The items offered by the arms trader and blacksmith are being changed. We want to make their stocks expand smoothly as the game progresses so that players won’t be able to buy 6th-tier swords at the very beginning of the game. Speaking of weapon tiers, there will be [b]8 tiers[/b] of weapons in total, but the 8th-tier (best) sword and bow won’t be available for purchase. Don’t worry, you’ll still be able to obtain them — you’ll just need to make it through some difficult challenges to do so, rather than simply buying them.

[b]This is just a small part of what we’re working on right now. [/b]We’ll have more news and teasers from version 1.0 for you soon.
